title: After-hours 23 Miles Private Helicopter Tour over Orlando Eye
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Helicopter tour (duration based on option selected)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

If you’re taking an After-hours tour: Please be advised sunset changes daily and you must look for the time that accommodates your wants. i.e. if you want a sunset, please look up sunset times for the time of year you’re wanting to fly. We are not responsible for the amount of light, darkness, or overcast during the time in which you book. Please plan accordingly.
It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers. Every seat is a window seat on this exciting Helicopter Tour!
People per ride: The helicopter fits 3 passengers at a time so if you have a party of 4 people or more, we will have to split them in two or more rides.
A minimum of 2 people per booking is required
Infants up to 2 years old (under 30lb/14kg) must sit on a lap and will fly for free.
Weight restrictions: One person CANNOT exceed 300lbs (136kg/21.4st) and the total weight for 3 people is 600lbs (272kg/42.8st). All passengers must be willing to be weighed for safety.
Arrival time: passengers must arrive 15 minutes prior to their scheduled departure. If you do not arrive within the specified timeframe, please contact us.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Just when you think it can't get any more awesome! We offer a 15 minute after-hours helicopter flight that shows you Central Florida parks at night! Observe Orlando Eye, Disney Springs, Fun Spot Kissimmee and Old Town for a breathtaking night experience. You will feel transformed into a sparkling sea of lights with this magical helicopter tour! It is a private helicopter tour! You will not be sharing the helicopter with other tour passengers. Every seat is a window seat on this exciting Helicopter Tour! Please be advised sunset changes daily and you must look for the time that accommodates your wants.
Flights are available throughout the day to work into your Florida vacation.
